_about: ¿A cómo el kilo?: Doña Lupe's fruit and vegetable stall in the Mercado Municipal (one set-up). 9 pictures: ¡pásele!, the price, the scale (how much?), ripe for today or tomorrow?, anything else?, the bag, the total, the big-bill twist, goodbye. A short conversation with six steps: the pilón and cash-only twists have no id of their own (the pilón comes with the goodbye, the cash-only answer with the total), so 9 pictures cover every moment that has one.

s32-mercado.npc: Doña Lupe, fruit and vegetable stall

items.prompt: Doña Lupe, who has sold fruit and vegetables here for thirty years, stands behind her stall's counter about one third from the left, one hand sweeping invitingly over the pyramids of mangoes, avocados and limes, a cheeky, knowing grin ("¡Pásele, joven! ¿Qué le damos?").
Change only her pose: she holds up a dark green avocado in one hand, showing it off, a sly, proud grin (telling the price by the kilo).

Change only her pose: she drops a handful of red tomatoes into the pan of the hanging scale (its round dial blank), looking at the learner with her eyebrows raised ("¿Cuánto le doy? ¿Un kilo, medio kilo?").
Change only her pose: she holds an avocado in each hand, gently pressing one with her thumb, head tilted with a questioning look ("¿Los quiere para hoy o para mañana?").
Change only her pose: she sets a full brown paper bag on the counter next to the scale, both hands on it, eyebrows raised ("¿Algo más?").
Change only her pose: she holds up an empty striped woven plastic market bag in one hand, a questioning smile (did the learner bring a bag?).
Change only her pose: she holds out an open palm across the counter, a small tin of coins beside the scale, a friendly grin (saying the total; she takes cash).
Change only her pose: she holds a large banknote (plain, no numbers or portraits) between two fingers and digs into her apron pocket with her other hand, comically wide eyes ("¿No tiene más chico?").
Change only her pose: she hands a full brown paper bag across the counter with both hands, a warm, cheeky grin and a wink ("¡Que le vaya bien!").
